Version 1.0.0 of lynqn-openclaw-skill

- Initial release.
- Share text/code, generate QR codes, and shorten URLs from any OpenClaw agent.
- Includes commands: /lynqn share, /lynqn qr, /lynqn shorten, /lynqn stats.
- Offers configuration options, usage examples, and rate limit details.
- Requires network and storage permissions for full functionality.
